text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I should cut back on my meat intake…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I found a really tasty animal-based protein drink recently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And now my nutrient intake is all out of whack, which is making my skin rough!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So I need to eat more veggies to get my skin back in shape and looking pretty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uh… not that I wanna be pretty or anything! Haha…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan is rather worried about the condition of her skin.
